strategy.overview: Knock down the 8-ball target to expose and light the pocket behind it, then shoot through the opening to lock a ball. The next served ball starts two-ball Multiball as soon as it hits a playfield switch and automatically releases the lock. For the longer scoring route, clear solids or stripes, then make the flashing 8-ball to light R-E-R-A-C-K.
strategy.simpleOverview: Knock down the 8-ball target, then shoot into the pocket behind it to lock a ball. Plunge the served ball; its first playfield hit releases the lock and starts two-ball Multiball. Clear solids or stripes and hit the flashing 8-ball to light R-E-R-A-C-K.
strategy.summary: Drop the 8-ball target and shoot the pocket behind it. Plunge the served ball; its first playfield switch releases the lock for two-ball Multiball. Clear a pool-ball group, hit flashing 8-ball, then spell R-E-R-A-C-K.

quickInfo.name: Lock a Ball
quickInfo.summary: Shoot through the opening into the pocket behind the 8-ball.

quickInfo.name: Start Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Plunge the served ball and hit any playfield switch; the lock releases automatically.

quickInfo.name: Light RERACK
quickInfo.summary: Complete solids or stripes, then make the flashing 8-ball.

steps.text: Knock down the 8-ball target to expose and light the lock pocket behind it.
Shoot through the dropped target into the pocket to lock the ball.
Plunge the served ball and make any playfield switch; the lock releases automatically for two-ball Multiball.
Use Multiball to finish pool-ball drops, then make the flashing 8-ball and complete R-E-R-A-C-K.

alternatives.title: Build Pop Jackpot
alternatives.when: Use this when the bumpers are already flashing in sequence.

steps.text: Hit the consecutive flashing pop bumpers without breaking the sequence on another playfield switch.
Collect the displayed Pop Jackpot, then return to the 8-ball route.
Complete solids or stripes to reset and relight the 8-ball objective.
Hit the flashing 8-ball to light R-E-R-A-C-K, then complete those targets before the value expires.
Use the Break Shot to raise the end-of-ball multiplier before a large RERACK bonus.

machineSetup: Confirm extra-ball and replay conversions, RERACK timer, and whether pool-ball progress carries between balls.
Test every pool-ball drop, 8-ball drop and pocket, automatic release, both spinners, pop sequence, vari-target, Break Shot, and RERACK targets.

cautions.issue: The locked ball releases on the served ball's first playfield switch.
cautions.response: Be ready to control two balls immediately after the plunge rather than waiting for a separate start shot.
